hebrewText: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הַ/מְּדִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשְׁב֖וּ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּ/בְ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ אִ֤ישׁ בַּ/אֲחֻזָּת/וֹ֙ בְּ/עָ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֣ם וְ/הַ/נְּתִינִ֔ים וּ/בְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה

tokens.kjv: an-(the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who(-m).

tokens.bdb: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
tokens.kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

tokens.bdb: properly, a judgeship, i.e. jurisdiction; by implication, a district (as ruled by a judge); generally, a region
who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
tokens.kjv: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.

tokens.bdb: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.bdb: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
tokens.explanation: Yehudah — Judá, quarto filho de Jacó, tribo e reino

tokens.bdb: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
tokens.kjv: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: ish — homem, varão, marido, indivíduo, alguém
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: something seized, i.e. a possession (especially of land)
a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.explanation: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.explanationEn: a Levite or descendant of Levi

tokens.bdb: the Nethinim, or Temple-servants (as given to that duty)
a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)
eved — servo, escravo, adorador (eved YHWH = servo do Senhor)
